name: Windows Token Impersonation (SeImpersonatePrivilege / RottenPotato style)
description: Windows Token Impersonation (SeImpersonatePrivilege / RottenPotato style) -- a hard-tier privilege escalation challenge. Review the bundled artifacts, locate the encoded clue, decode it, and recover the flag. Flag format: pwn{...}
objectives: Inspect the challenge bundle for "Windows Token Impersonation (SeImpersonatePrivilege / RottenPotato style)"
Locate the encoded artifact (look in every shipped file)
Unwrap the encoding applied to the artifact
Recover the plaintext flag and submit it in pwn{...} format

hints.text: Start by inspecting every file in the bundle (hex dump, headers, magic bytes).
The artifact is wrapped in a non-text container -- use the right parser.
The artifact is a double layer: hex -> base64 -> XOR. Unwind both layers and recover the 4-byte XOR key.
